name: Lp, Lena
overview: LP, Lena is a series about an endearingly confused young woman who is at a turning point in her seemingly perfect life. When the shocking truth of her longstanding relationship comes to light, it triggers a domino effect of hilariously absurd events that are bound to change her forever. LP, Lena is therefore a series about saying goodbye - goodbye to a carefree life - an ode to Alenka Preseren and her journey to adulthood. In the second season of the series, we gain insight into the lives of millennial young adults through the prism of four different couples. Lena and her friends are trying to grasp the realities of growing up, but at the same time fall into just about all of the pitfalls it sets for them.
